champion.tips: KLED TIPS AND TRICKS Abuse Kled’s duelling potential early by trading with the enemy as frequently as you can. Play overly aggressive if you know the enemy cannot match your damage. Don’t be afraid to roam with your Ultimate R to help other lanes out. If you’re ahead, you could recall and use your Ultimate R to help bot lane. Extended trades will always work in your favour, so go for extended trades over short ones whenever you can. Preferably, trade around your W .
champion.builds: THE BEST KLED BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kled Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Demolish in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Titanic Hydra as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Hullbreaker. For your last 3 items, you should build Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage and finish with Black Cleaver. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 54.3% winrate over 3 117 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Demolish in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Eclipse as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Titanic Hydra as a third item. You want to finish the build with Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage and Overlord's Bloodmail. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 52.0% win rate across 512 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kled Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Demolish as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Profane Hydra as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Voltaic Cyclosword as third item. The last 3 options are Black Cleaver, The Collector and Infinity Edge. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 58.1% win rate over 449 matches played. Situational Kled Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kled build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kled runes page.
